selected_exact_results.title: Two-history molecular interferometry has a concrete proposed access model and sharp erasure-completion limits
selected_exact_results.status: source_derived_unreviewed; external correctness, novelty, and physical capability UNKNOWN
selected_exact_results.underused_opportunity: Use a sharp erasure-inclusive completion region to turn a molecular survivor fringe into a defensible full-history overlap interval; currently the apparatus proposal has no new experiment.
selected_exact_results.exact_statement_and_quantifiers: For each finite-dimensional common physical experiment with the same input rho, branch isometries V_A,V_B, and common survival projector P, let p_j be branch survival probability, q_j=1-p_j, z_s the unnormalised survivor overlap, and L=Tr(V_B^dagger V_A rho) the full overlap. Then |z_s|<=sqrt(p_A p_B) and |L-z_s|<=sqrt(q_A q_B). If each output sector may have dimension at least two, every L in the stated disk is attainable from the observed p_A,p_B,z_s; the disk is sharp. For equal survival p_A=p_B=1-q, L is in (1-q)m + disk(radius q), with m=z_s/(1-q).
selected_exact_results.decision_changed: A conditional survivor fringe alone cannot certify the full-history echo or a nonlinear molecular response. Acquire loss/erasure counts and both quadratures under one common dilation, then optimize the sharp disk over one joint confidence region. The result is an overlap completion bound, not a molecular-identity, anharmonicity, lifetime, or thermodynamic certificate.
selected_exact_results.strongest_comparator: Known ancilla/channel-interference and ion action/2D-IR spectroscopy are prior methods. The same-target total-cost comparator is UNKNOWN; compare against the strongest equally informed spectroscopy method after acquisition and controls.
selected_exact_results.physical_interface_gate: G-FE-N796-CAPABILITY remains open. Acquire both quadratures with interleaved order-swap, randomized-phase, single-pulse, off-resonant, common-branch, and atomic-background controls; record molecular identity/reset and every erasure; measure the full propagation/Stark/phase/contrast channel, trial rate, and uniform loss/systematic budget; then test a declared target against the best same-budget method.
selected_exact_results.complete_cost_boundary: Preparation, reset, branch addressing/recombination, phase and Stark calibration, shared bath, motion, leakage, erasure detection, accepted and rejected trial counts, and full-cycle repetition rate are unacquired. Source scenario pulse rate and trial rate are not apparatus measurements.
selected_exact_results.previous_failure_or_countermodel: The source constructs identical identity reduced molecular channels with H_A=H_B=0 and J_A=sqrt(gamma)I, J_B=+/-sqrt(gamma)I, yet the fringe is respectively 1 or exp(-2 gamma t). Thus branch marginals do not determine cross-history coherence. A sharp example has perfect survivor coherence m=1 and full echo L=0.98 with 1% full-branch failure.
current_routes_and_notices: SN-FG-N796-PARKING-IDENTIFIABILITY: N799's ground-label parking, loaded reference, and two-band separator do not automatically close calibration or three-band countermodels.

selected_exact_results.title: Phase-selective crystal rewriting: optical symmetry, retention, and physical acquisition gates
selected_exact_results.status: source_derived_unreviewed; no phase-selected GaAs operation, yield, cost, or scaling established
selected_exact_results.underused_opportunity: Treat symmetry as a fast falsifier for control without full microscopic identification: mobility or symmetric heating cannot choose a signed variant; a true phase-odd conjugate bias is necessary in the stated finite-state model.
selected_exact_results.exact_statement_and_quantifiers: For any finite configuration space with an involution iota exchanging the two actual variants, signed order parameter M(iota x)=-M(x), symmetric initial law p_0(iota x)=p_0(x), and a time-dependent CTMC generator satisfying Q_t(iota x,iota y)=Q_t(x,y) for all x,y,t, the law remains symmetric for all finite t, E[M_t]=0, and positive/negative variant probabilities agree except for a symmetry-invariant tie class. This covers any symmetric temperature history and common positive mobility multiplier a(t)Q_0. A phase-odd field may select only conditionally: it must be a real conjugate field with local detailed balance and phase reversal must exchange the entire driven structural law. The actual coupling and target variants must be acquired.
selected_exact_results.manufacture_interface: The target is retained phase-selected boundary motion/polarity on one mapped inversion-related GaAs specimen, with nonzero tensor geometry, a predeclared post-drive horizon, and an observed 3D structural endpoint. Translation-only antiphase variants are not assumed to reverse the tensor.
selected_exact_results.additional_exact_screen: Under equal-molar, fixed-composition, equilibrium-melting, negligible-heat-exchange dose partition with actual net thermal inputs Q(1+C) and Q(1-C), complete melting of one region while the other stays below onset requires C>L/(2 H_s+L). The cited GaAs heat-content inputs give conditional C>0.44849. Carrier contrast is not net lattice heat, and correct regrowth is separate.
selected_exact_results.decision_changed: Reject symmetric mobility acceleration as a polarity selector. For an impulsive full-melt implementation, measure the actual thermal contrast and stop if it cannot exceed the conditional threshold; this threshold does not exclude sustained heating, nonthermal melting, partial/boundary-local transformations, or other kinetics.
selected_exact_results.strongest_comparator: The target-matched incumbent is capped GaAs-on-Si annealing; orientation-patterned GaAs growth is a fabrication comparator that forms a new patterned device rather than rewriting a retained existing layer.
selected_exact_results.physical_interface_gate: G-FO-N821-CAPABILITY remains open. Measure phase-reversed retained boundary/structure after drive removal on a mapped inversion-related sample, with local carrier, heat, field and CASH calibration; matched thermal/electric/single-colour/random-phase controls; stoichiometry, damage, yield; and full cost against annealing/template growth.
selected_exact_results.complete_cost_boundary: Coupling/bias strength, absorbed heat, carriers, reset, defect/boundary mapping, local field, temperature, pulse train, retained-output measurement, damage/yield, process throughput, and full annealing/template baseline cost remain unacquired.
previous_failures_or_countermodels: A symmetric generator with symmetric initial law cannot produce sign selection; common mobility scaling only changes the clock.
At zero optical contrast, unequal patch cooling can cause one region to melt and the other not; geometry can fake apparent selection.
A sustained-heating-with-cooling model defeats a universal impossibility claim based only on the impulsive threshold; its time/cost grows as contrast shrinks.
A measured carrier-generation contrast does not establish net thermal-energy contrast or retained structural sign.

SN-FR-coupled-physical-bias-and-endpoint: newer field/shear models add root/interface, hot mixed absorption, independent-port-null, and matched retained-endpoint gates.

selected_exact_results.title: Polarity-conjugate optical and electromechanical drives require coupled same-regime retained-output qualification
selected_exact_results.status: source_derived_unreviewed; no measured hot material response or retained operation
selected_exact_results.underused_opportunity: Screen an active phase-ramped wall conveyor on a mapped, mobile, non-rooted boundary. This avoids demanding a complete microscopic state reconstruction, while still requiring enough acquired geometry, conjugate-field calibration, and a retained endpoint.
selected_exact_results.exact_statement_and_quantifiers: For prescribed undepleted forward fields and a uniform rectangular rigid wall with real tensor contraction, fixed tangent lengths L_1,L_2 and normal position X, F_X/A=p_0 sinc(q_t1 L_1/2)sinc(q_t2 L_2/2) cos(Phi+q_n X+q_t dot r_c). A tangent direction spanning an integer beat length has exactly zero net force for every external phase; an infinite flat wall has zero mean pressure for any nonzero tangent mismatch. If q_n is nonzero and tangent overlap fixed, a static phase produces a periodic potential with zero work per normal beat and no directed stationary current in the stated deterministic/isothermal gradient model. With Phi(t)=-q_n v t, positive q_n and |v|<M P give a stable locked solution of eta_dot=q_n[M P cos eta-v], advancing a freely moving wall at programmed speed v.
selected_exact_results.decision_changed: A static optical phase is not a sustained transport operation in the stated model. A phase ramp is a conditional mechanism candidate only when measured overlap P, normal mismatch q_n, mobility M, legal wall exit, and sign-reversed retained output coexist. The self-generated harmonic is even under global variant inversion; an independently phase-locked injected harmonic is needed to supply an odd reference in the stated model.
selected_exact_results.countermodel_or_failure: Tangent beat averaging can cancel the whole-wall force despite nonzero local pressure; static normal mismatch stalls in a periodic potential; an unseeded self-generated harmonic does not choose polarity; and a fixed substrate root persists even when the free surface moves. These are model-scoped obstructions, not universal no-go results.
selected_exact_results.strongest_comparator: Capped GaAs annealing and orientation-patterned/template growth; the latter fabricates a new patterned device. Barrett et al.'s GaAs-on-Si anneal is direct evidence: capped samples at 650 C for 7.5 minutes reduced surface APB density from 0.10 to 0.014 micrometre^-1; the paper reports a nonzero plateau and does not test phase-selected rewriting.
selected_exact_results.physical_interface_gate: G-FR-N832-CAPABILITY remains open: qualify one mapped nearly planar boundary with an exit, independently calibrated conjugate controls and matched heat/carrier conditions; require sign-reversed retained 3D polarity/function and full cost against annealing/growth.
selected_exact_results.complete_cost_boundary: Acquire wall orientation, tensor projection, hot complex optical overlap and attenuation, phase noise, seed/branch control, heat/carriers, boundary stiffness/tension and mobility, pinning and root-release path, source energy, absorption, duty cycle, microscopy/readout, yield and matched process throughput. No common operating window is supplied.
